statements.status_notes: Upgrading brace-expansion from 1.x to the fixed version 5.0.5 is a major version jump that breaks plugin bootstrap due to puppeteer postinstall hooks. Waiting for upstream OpenSearch Dashboards plugins to update their dependency.
